attribs.name: character_backstory
attribs.current:
I was born to an underground sect of the drow half-elves who separated themselves from the rest of the world, in order to practice dark magic, and  research the origin of magic. they would perform various experiments on newborns and i was one of them. i was infused with a shard filled with the blood from an abyssal demon.

this shard gifted me magical prowess, and made me the first creature to not experience any side effects after such an experiment... or so we thought. 
when i was 16, i started experiencing nightmares about the abyssal plane, where i would be subjected to torment for hours. Over time these nightmares would start becoming more and more clear, and i would start feeling pain through these nightmares. 

after a point, the pain was unbearable. so i tried communicating with the shard. a few days into trying, the shard started to communicate back, the demon whose blood was stored inside me was haunting me, driving me insane so that it could take over my mind. the demon identified itself as nevermore, defender of the eldritch temple.

in order to survive, i would make a deal with nevermore. he would let me use  his powers at free will, and i would send him the souls of ones that i kill, along with my own at my death. i would write this down in a book. that would later become my grimoire to use my eldritch evocations, and would also become my spellcasting focus.

i would quickly escape the half-elf society at the age of 21 as i did not trust myself to handle this power. i would go around battlefields and assist random armies, as to satisfy the hunger of nevermore without feeling guilty.
